scope: Four technology or practice claims recovered from the 2026-08-10 TikTok batch
method: Video URLs are preserved exactly. TikTok retrieval was unreachable in the local video audit, so claims are bounded by retained notes and independently identified official sources; no installation or smoke test is inferred.

cloudflare-os.conclusion: Official project identified and source reviewed; not installed or run locally. Marketing claims such as absolute safety are unproven.

self-evolving-skills.conclusion: Only an architectural concept was retained. No concrete implementation or repository was identified, so there is nothing installable to test.

open-source-ai-crm-unknown.conclusion: The retained video note does not name a repository or product precisely enough to verify license, install, or behavior. Guessing a tool name is forbidden.

short-video-retention-apv.conclusion: Official YouTube guidance supports retention/average percentage viewed as signals among several signals. No official evidence found that APV always has the highest weight.
